python_interfaces.name: ServiceRequestRepository
python_interfaces.rule: reader is Snapshot or current UnitOfWork; command-time identity/revision checks use current UoW; repositories never commit

python_interfaces.name: ServiceRequestReferenceRepository
python_interfaces.rule: owns only LLD-03 SR reference history; LLD-02 owns Customer/Contact masters and affiliation

python_interfaces.name: ServiceRequestSourcePresenceRepository
python_interfaces.rule: schema/sr-source-presence.json is sole storage authority; append requires exact current chain head and never commits

python_interfaces.name: ServiceRequestReferenceService
python_interfaces.contract: Customer changes preserve history and invoke LLD-06 in the same UoW. Contact changes validate LLD-02 lifecycle/affiliation. current_handler_reference resolves only the exact current accepted handler observation; token binds current relationship/master/source authority.

python_interfaces.name: RfcRepository
python_interfaces.rule: current UoW owns command-time identity/revision/archive checks; role/source lifecycle are derived elsewhere

python_interfaces.name: RfcHierarchyRepository
python_interfaces.rule: all writes go through RfcHierarchyService; repository never commits

python_interfaces.name: SrRfcRelationshipRepository
python_interfaces.rule: direct root links only; subordinate context is query-derived

python_interfaces.name: TicketDeviceRelationshipRepository
python_interfaces.rule: closed owner dispatch with static SQL

python_interfaces.name: WorkingNoteRepository
python_interfaces.rule: owner/creator provenance is immutable; import has no note writer

python_interfaces.name: RfcLifecycleRepository
python_interfaces.rule: projection is rebuildable; cascade/archive authority preserves governed history

python_interfaces.name: ServiceRequestImportReader
python_interfaces.rule: general import token binds current SR/projection/reference authority; source_presence_base_token is independently defined by algorithms/sr-source-presence.json and binds the immutable presence-chain head

python_interfaces.name: ServiceRequestImportMutationService
python_interfaces.contract: LLD-04 owns the outer receipt/UoW and immutable evidence. LLD-03 revalidates owner state, writes only owned tables, and never commits or creates another receipt. Handler text changes only through source projection. Presence methods mutate only schema/sr-source-presence.json and accept no source fields or ticket lifecycle changes.

python_interfaces.name: RfcImportReader
python_interfaces.rule: Canonical callable semantics and exact SOMA_RFC_SOURCE_ACCEPTANCE_BASE_V1 bytes are owned by interfaces/cross-packet-v2.json. Source acceptance binds RFC identity plus accepted RFC source projection only; unrelated local RFC authority is deliberately excluded.

python_interfaces.name: RfcImportMutationService
python_interfaces.rule: uses LLD-04 outer UoW/receipt, performs LLD-03 checks/writes, never commits independently; provisional WFM eligibility never fabricates Enhanced RFC status and terminal source acceptance never executes cascade

python_interfaces.name: SrSourceProjectionService
python_interfaces.rule: schema/sr-source-projection.json and algorithms/sr-source-current.json define field authority; exact LLD-04 evidence is provider-validated with no physical cross-packet FK

reader_contract: reader means framework Snapshot or current UnitOfWork. Command-time uniqueness/revision/relationship/lifecycle decisions use current UoW, never a pre-lock Snapshot.
cross_domain_transaction_rule: Cross-packet mutation participants receive the existing LLD-01 UnitOfWork, mutate only their owner packet, never commit/rollback independently, and return bounded immutable result evidence. One outer receipt exists; required participant failure/INDETERMINATE aborts the transaction.
hard_delete_guard_rule: Preview/commit combine LLD-03 local checks with RfcSourceEvidenceProvider, RfcTerminalTaskParticipant, RfcTerminalCommunicationParticipant and RfcInventoryDependencyProvider; every classifier must be determinate CLEAR.
cross_domain_rules: LLD-02 owns Customer/Contact/Local User Profile masters; LLD-03 owns their ticket references/history only.
Current Handler text remains source-owned evidence; current_handler_reference is only reviewed identity resolution of its exact current observation.
LLD-04 owns workbook evidence/proposals and calls only declared LLD-03 import services; LLD-03 stores provider-validated opaque evidence IDs with no sequence-3/14 FK into LLD-04.

Reviewed SR source-presence history is LLD-03 authority under algorithms/sr-source-presence.json; LLD-04 validates evidence and schedules bounded automatic reappearance but never owns the warning state.
LLD-06 participates only in canonical SR Customer change consequences and never silently remaps classification.
LLD-05 owns WFM/Task/Objective lifecycle; LLD-03 never writes it directly.
LLD-08 owns DeviceReference-to-NetworkElement resolution; ticket links remain DeviceReference-based.
LLD-09 owns Communication state; terminal cascade crosses only the declared bounded same-UoW participant.
